remarks: PACK THE FAMILY & DOG AND LIVE IN WESTPORT!   Welcome to the Lucky Seven House!   The house's name reflects the current owners' love of entertaining and gatherings that prompt people to return again and again thus making it the lucky, happy house to be in. You'll find it's easy to fall in love with both the home and its convenient beach community neighborhood. Get ready to cook with an eat-in professional kitchen w/chef-favorite appliances & an island that flows into the large family room, living room and playroom. Memories are made here and forever cherished as this completely renovated, loved and adored home offers style, grace and the perfect location with all the benefits of Westport residency. Walk to the train station, Longshore, and Compo Beach and immerse yourself in the Westport beach lifestyle and fun. Casual luxury personified in one delightfully enchanting home.
